title: Geometric reducedness of local rings is invariant under field base change
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $L/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], $R$ a commutative $k$-algebra, and $S=R\otimes_kL$, with multiplication $(r\otimes a)(s\otimes b)=rs\otimes ab$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\{r\in R:r\otimes1\in\mathfrak q\}$. Set $A=R_{\mathfrak p}$ and $B=S_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then the following are equivalent: (1) for every field extension $E/k$ the ring $A\otimes_kE$ is reduced; (2) for every field extension $H/L$ the ring $B\otimes_LH$ is reduced. Here reduced means that every nilpotent element is zero. No finite type, Noetherian, algebraicity, or closed-point hypothesis is imposed.
